name: pocket-squad
description: A lean Claude Code workflow in your pocket: /ps:init (CLAUDE.md + PRODUCT.md + ARCHITECTURE.md), /ps:story (refine → .squad/stories), /ps:run (one worktree, tasks in order, one PR per story), /ps:review (fresh eyes, two parallel lenses, once per story), /ps:publish (squash-merge + sweep + learnings).
